records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales from the Retail segment accounted for approximately 85.2% of consolidated net sales for the nine months ended October 31, 2025, compared to 87.9% for the comparable period in fiscal 2025.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Comparable store net sales increased as a result of higher store traffic, transactions and average unit retail, while conversion rate was flat and units per transaction decreased.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Total inventory at October 31, 2025, as compared to October 31, 2024, increased by $46.5 million, or 5.9%, to $839.8 million.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Selling, general and administrative expenses increased by $50.4 million, or 13.7%, in the third quarter of fiscal 2026 compared to the third quarter of fiscal 2025.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Income from operations was 9.4% of net sales, or $144.3 million, for the third quarter of fiscal 2026 compared to 9.4% of net sales, or $128.7 million, for the third quarter of fiscal 2025.
